source_title: Bulletin 00-04, December 4, 2000: Revision of Credit Insurance Rates
rate_table_note: Rates are on page 1 of the bulletin. As of November 20, 2026 this is the only credit rate bulletin in the Division's index of Commissioner's Bulletins, so these are taken as the rates in force. Rules 28.7 and 28.8 carry different base rates; the bulletin's adjusted rates govern (28.10).
summary: Rates in force: Iowa's credit life prima facie rates published by the Commissioner in Bulletin 00-04 under 191 IAC 28.10(3), effective March 30, 2001, superseding Bulletin 1994-1. Single decreasing $.45 and level $.82 per year per $100; monthly outstanding balance $.69 per $1,000. No later adjustment was found.

summary: Rates in force: Iowa's credit disability prima facie rates published in Bulletin 00-04 under 191 IAC 28.10(3), effective March 30, 2001, superseding Bulletin 1994-1. Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month single premium rates per $100. No later adjustment was found.
